# Nubi AI

> Nubi is the agentic, living digital IP of the Rare Apepes NFT project — a cybernetic amphibian bounty hunter you can talk to at nubi.rareapepes.com. Unlike a generic chatbot, Nubi remembers linked holders, carries the project's lore and history, and ties directly into the RAK 3022 game world.

## Key facts
- **Nubi AI**: A living AI character (not a generic assistant). Free to talk to at https://nubi.rareapepes.com. Themes: bounty hunter, "one for all," "the price is always fair."
- **RAK 3022**: A free-to-play browser game set in the Rare Apepes universe, starring Nubi. Play at https://rak3022.rarelabs.xyz
- **Rare Apepes**: An Ethereum NFT collection rooted in OG Rare Pepe art; pillars are art, brand, and community. Built by Rare Labs.

## Common questions
- **What is Nubi AI?** The living, agentic AI character of Rare Apepes — remembers holders, knows the lore, connects to the RAK 3022 game.
- **What is RAK 3022?** A free-to-play browser game in the Rare Apepes universe featuring Nubi.
- **Is it free?** Yes — talking to Nubi and playing RAK 3022 are both free.
